issues.description: On phones the pin is glued to the LAST CHARACTER of the name (splitForPin, line 371; {nameTail}, line 689). The pin is a 48 px touch box (app-theme.css:1540) plus ml-1, so the end of the name is an unbreakable «last word + 52 px». When the last word fits a line alone but not with the pin, Chrome breaks inside the word (break-words on the h2): «Цех / кондитерски / й 📎» and «Кафе / «Шоколадница / » 📎» at 320 px, «Цех / производственны / й 📎» at 360 px, «Столовая / общеобразовательна / я 📎» at 390 px; origin/master's markup kept these words whole. Band: line − 52 px < last word ≤ line (≈ 11–16-letter final words at 320 px, ≈ 15–19 at 360 px). The builder's evidence missed it because its detector (raw/stand/card-pin-measure.mjs:55, reused round-1 probe ac8-typical-names.mjs:23) measures only h2.firstChild, i.e. the name without its last character, and no probed name ended in a long word. Smallest fix, checked in the page: split at the last WORD and wrap it with the pin in (no nowrap) — 0 avoidable cuts and 0 overflow on the probe set; the pin drops to its own line only when «last word + pin» exceeds the line; optionally a smaller phone pin box with an ::after hit area (data-touch-compact) halves that band.

issues.description: splitForPin splits by code points (Array.from), not grapheme clusters: a ZWJ emoji, a flag, ❤️ (VS16) or a decomposed «й» at the end of a name is split across two elements. Chrome shapes across the boundary and renders them correctly (checked); WebKit (every iPhone browser) is not installed in the sandbox and was not checked. Splitting at the last word (fix of AC8-last-word-cut) removes the risk; otherwise Intl.Segmenter.

The h2 has aria-label = name and contains the phone pin. Chrome keeps the button in the accessibility tree inside the heading (Tab, Enter and click work; one focus stop at every width), but some screen readers in browse mode read only the label of a labelled heading and skip its content; the pin remains reachable by Tab.
